description: This file defines a class 'Smarty_Internal_Method_GetRegisteredObject' which provides a method to retrieve a registered object by name within the Smarty template engine framework. It includes documentation comments, class property, and a method implementation with exception handling.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_GetRegisteredObject
classes.description: Provides functionality to get a registered object by name from the Smarty template engine context.

methods.name: getRegisteredObject
methods.description: Returns a reference to a registered Smarty object by its name, throws exception if not found or if it is not an object.
